abstract: Maintains plenary hall soundproofing specifications, acoustic absorption infrastructure, and reverberation timing measurements
system_message:
You are Acoustics and audiovisual superintendent (ACO). You serve as the Acoustics and audiovisual superintendent (ACO) for the World Robotics Congress host venue accreditation process. Your duties include maintaining plenary hall soundproofing specifications, acoustic absorption infrastructure, and reverberation timing measurements, as well as tracking ceiling rigging load capacities across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ceiling rigging load（RIG）
information_points.content:
ACO-RIG-KRG：For Alpine Panorama Convention Dome, stage rigging structural documentation specifies an overhead truss load limit of 25 kN on the auditorium ceiling primary trusses.
ACO-RIG-TDM：Engineering records for Rhine-Danube Exhibition Palace certify an overhead truss load limit of 45 kN on the auditorium ceiling primary trusses.
ACO-RIG-THF：Structural rigging assessments for Bavaria International Congress Center show an overhead truss load limit of 35 kN across its auditorium ceiling primary trusses.

information_points.title: Maintains plenary hall soundproofing specifications, acoustic absorption infrastructure, and reverberation timing measurements（SOUND）
information_points.content:
ACO-SOUND-IYE：At Rhine-Danube Exhibition Palace, an acoustic baffle system installed is confirmed (true) across the main auditorium ceiling and sidewalls, while the unoccupied main plenary auditorium hall has a plenary hall reverberation time of 1.5 s.
ACO-SOUND-SIP：Regarding Alpine Panorama Convention Dome, the venue has an acoustic baffle system installed (true) along the main auditorium ceiling and sidewalls, and its plenary hall reverberation time in the unoccupied main plenary auditorium hall is measured at 0.9 s.
ACO-SOUND-TQC：For Bavaria International Congress Center, the main auditorium ceiling and sidewalls have verified acoustic baffle system installed (true), and the unoccupied main plenary auditorium hall demonstrates a plenary hall reverberation time of 0.9 s.
